description: Secured liabilities from the latest financial-statement notes (period ending 2025+): mortgages (hipoteki), registered / financial pledges (zastawy), transfers of ownership, assignments — with creditor, amount, secured debt, asset and land-register (KW) numbers. krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.
